reviews.text: Scott and his team have been serving and maintaining our pool for over 15 years and have done a fantastic job!  They have fixed many of the issues that we have had and from plumbing, to plaster repair, and replaced all of the rock work and coping!  Best in the Business!!!!  I highly recommend them for all of your pool needs from new construction to monthly maintenance!
reviews.author: Tim Davis

reviews.text:
Partnering with BlueWater Pools LLC has been nothing short of outstanding. From the start, their team creates a welcoming, family-like atmosphere that makes collaboration seamless and genuinely enjoyable. Their sales and operations teams stand out for their meticulous attention to detail, ensuring every step of the custom pool building and remodeling process is executed flawlessly.

At the helm, Scott, President and CEO, brings unmatched expertise in the pool industry. His leadership is evident in the consistent delivery of projects that are completed on schedule and within budget, an achievement that’s not only impressive but critical for long-term business success. The entire team champions clear communication and precise execution, giving partners confidence that every project will stay on track and aligned with shared goals.

Simply put, the quality, professionalism, and reliability of BlueWater Pools set them apart as a premier partner. For anyone seeking a pool builder or service provider they can truly trust, BlueWater Pools deserves to be at the top of the list!
reviews.author: Drew Gonick

reviews.text: I have known and worked with Scott McFarland and Blue Water Pools for over 20+ years.  Honest, Dependable, Reliable and Professional Company.  If you need a company that will go above and beyond - one call does it all.  Keep doing a great for our Industry!
reviews.author: Brant Rydberg

reviews.text: Best group of professionals to work with, when planning a pool build, and continuing with pool service when finished.  Enjoyed working with them throughout the process. Would definitely recommend them to build your backyard oasis.
reviews.author: Jackie Rose

reviews.text:
Let's start with our pool being green half the time. It seems they intentionally let the pool turn green in order to charge even more services (ie. filter cleans). In 5 months we've had 3 filter cleanings, and the pool has never been worse.

This company does not deserve a 1-Star Review. They deserve 0.

To start, the Office Staff (as so many mention) are very rude and unprofessional.  They will deny this blaming my wife who merely held them accountable to promises made (can't wait to see that reply), but the truth is - they are the unprofessional ones and would treat her so disrespectfully time and time again.

I will not name names, although it has been mentioned in previous reviews, and ownership should really consider hiring new people for the office.

In regards to "pool techs" - they cannot keep them and are constantly running around putting fires out, because techs are quitting all the time. At first I had empathy for the supervisors, but over the past few weeks I've realized, this company is beyond disorganized and it's no wonder people do not want to work with them.

In all fairness, we have an older, somewhat difficult pool. However, one team member was able to get the pool into shape and keep it there for 2-3 months. The minute she left, everything changed. We did not have techs come out for at least one week we know of, maybe 2, and those that did stayed 5 minutes. Not nearly enough time to add chemicals. We saw this with our own eyes, by the way. And the pool immediately and quickly declined due to the lack of care by this team.

Now, I am stuck with a green pool that needs a complete overhaul yet, the minute we fire them they still invoice us. It's hysterical, really. I guess the $800 we forked over last week to get the pool BACK in order isn't enough for them, but I digress.

Something to note: the supervisors make promises they never intend on keeping. Intention is the key word here. We were told several times people would be out to help us get the pool back in order after our tech resigned, but they never showed. Instead - they listed things I needed to do for them to do their job, which I did by the way, and still continued to put us off for over a week.

When my wife called the office to hold this company accountable, the office manager laid her phone down and refused to listen to our frustrations. That's the kind of company you will be dealing with, should you decide to hire them.

I chuckled when I read that review about a supervisor - "always an excuse." Yep, spot on.

As a business owner, I wholeheartedly encourage anyone reading this review to find another Pool Company.

You will regret hiring Blue Water Pools, I assure you.
reviews.author: edward frys

reviews.text: Don't use them. They worked on my pool for 4 years couldn't get it to stop cracking. After the 3rd time they came out and did major work they stopped calling me back. Went to the office to talk to the owner and he hid in his office and they told me he wasn't there. He never called me back.
reviews.author: Scott Campbell

reviews.text: From start to finish, Blue Water has been amazing. Scott drew out what we wanted and took the time to help us choose all of the customizations we were looking for. They got started right away and kept us updated with the timeline. Frankie was awesome, he always asked if we had any questions and explained every step of the process very well so we were in the loop. They got the job done in a timely manner and did it well. It was SUCH a smooth process from start to finish. I’ve heard horror stories about other pool companies and we’re so glad we didn’t choose anyone else but Blue Water because we did not experience anything negative with them at all. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Jessica Wheeler

reviews.text: I'm a realtor and was showing my buyer a property with a pool when Hayden (so sorry if I spelled that wrong) popped in to do his regular servicing. We began asking him many questions as neither myself or the buyer have experiences with pools. Hayden was incredibly helpful, kind, and knowledgeable. He spent time answering all of our questions, giving quotes on what he could, and gave us phone numbers and names to reach out to in office for the quotes he couldn't give us.
reviews.author: Marissa Hemenway
